instruction.text: Raina Rainmaker’s mouth is so dry. Help Edgar Earthworm choose the right advice for Raina.

b.sound: Have a glass of water. I think all that rainmaking made you thirsty!
Go for a run. I think you’re feeling restless!

feedback.end: When our body needs water, it feels thirst. A dry mouth or a headache are signs that tell you you are thirsty.
Our bodies need water to survive. It is even more important than food. That’s why Raina is having a glass of water now.

instruction.text: How many glasses of water should superheroes and children drink in one whole day? Choose the right answer.

hint.text: This advice is for children between the ages of 4-13. Older people should drink even more water.

feedback.end: Children and superheroes should drink at least 6-8 glasses of water in one whole day.

instruction.text: When should Raina drink more? Choose the right answer.

b.sound: When she has been flying around and making it rain all over the place.
When she and Edgar have sat on the sofa all day.

feedback.end: Just like Raina, you should drink more water when you have moved or exercised a lot.

b.sound: When the weather is warm and she has been sweating a lot.

feedback.end: Our bodies use up a lot of water in warm weather. So, just like Raina, you should drink more water when the weather is warm.
